title: polyman Config.json
description: Schema for a polyman problem's Config.json. Mirrors the ConfigFile type in src/types.d.ts. Paths are relative to the problem directory.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema. Ignored by polyman; used by editors for validation.

problemId.description: Polygon problem ID. Set automatically by `polyman remote push` / `remote pull`. Absent for a problem that has never been pushed.

name.description: Polygon problem name: lowercase letters, digits and single dashes only. Immutable after the first push.

owner.description: Polygon username of the problem owner.

revision.description: Polygon revision number recorded by `remote pull`.

timeLimit.description: Time limit in milliseconds, applied to every solution.

inputFile.description: Input source. Keep "stdin" unless the problem explicitly reads from a file.

outputFile.description: Output target. Keep "stdout" unless the problem explicitly writes to a file.

interactive.description: Whether the problem is interactive. Rare; requires an interactor on Polygon.

description.description: Short problem description shown in Polygon's problem list.

tutorial.description: Problem-level tutorial text pushed to Polygon.

statements.description: One entry per statement language, keyed by Polygon language name ("english", "russian", ...).

solutions.description: All solutions. Exactly one must carry tag "MA".

generators.description: testlib generators referenced by name from generator scripts.

testsets.description: Testsets. Usually a single one named "tests".

SolutionTag.description: Expected verdict. MA = main correct (exactly one), OK = correct, WA = wrong answer, TL = time limit, TO = TLE-or-OK, ML = memory limit, RE = runtime error, PE = presentation error, RJ = rejected for any reason.

SolutionSourceType.description: Polygon compiler/interpreter identifier. Solutions may be C++, Java or Python.

legend.description: Path to the LaTeX legend fragment.

input.description: Path to the LaTeX input-format fragment.

output.description: Path to the LaTeX output-format fragment.

scoring.description: Path to the LaTeX scoring fragment.

interaction.description: Path to the LaTeX interaction-protocol fragment (interactive problems).

notes.description: Path to the LaTeX notes fragment.

tutorial.description: Path to the LaTeX tutorial fragment.

name.description: Identifier used by `polyman run <name>` and `polyman test <name>`.

source.description: Path to the solution source file.

name.description: Generator name as used in the generator script (no extension).

source.description: Path to the generator C++ source (must use testlib.h).
Custom checker: path to the C++ source. Standard checker (isStandard=true): the file name shipped with polyman, e.g. "wcmp.cpp" (see `polyman list checkers`).

isStandard.description: True to use one of polyman's bundled testlib checkers instead of a custom source.

testsFilePath.description: Path to the checker self-test JSON (ignored for standard checkers).

source.description: Path to the validator C++ source (must use testlib.h).

testsFilePath.description: Path to the validator self-test JSON.

GeneratorScript.description: Polygon-format generator script, inline or in a file. Provide exactly one of `script` / `scriptFile`.

scriptFile.description: Path to a file containing the script.

input.description: Path to the hand-written input file (convention: ./manual/<testset>/m-<NN>[-label].in).

output.description: Optional path to a reference output file.

index.description: 1-based Polygon test index. Must be unique within the testset, including indices used by the script.

group.description: Test group name (must be declared in the testset's `groups`).

points.description: Points for this test when `pointsEnabled` is true.

useInStatements.description: Whether the test is shown as a sample in the statement.

name.description: Group name referenced by manual tests and `<#-- @group name -->` script headers.

dependencies.description: Names of groups that must pass before this one is judged.

name.description: Testset name, usually "tests". Tests are written to ./testsets/<name>/.
